{%- comment -%}
Same order as the Group page: current members alphabetically by surname,
former members newest first and alphabetically within a year. The pre-sort on
`alu` is reversed because Liquid's stable `sort` means the trailing `reverse`
would otherwise flip the names within each year as well.
{%- endcomment -%}

{%- assign members = cur | concat: alu %}
